newsitem.title: USA: Chase launches free online banking service.
newsitem.headline: Chase launches free online banking service.

text.p: Chase Manhattan Corp said Monday it has started an online banking service which will be free to individuals and small business customers.
Michael Hegarty, Chase vice chairman, said in a statement the bank expects several hundred thousand customers to sign up for the service over the next two years.

Chase said customers will be able to check account balances, track account activity such as paid checks and deposits credited, transfer funds between accounts, pay bills and send E-mail to Chase customer service representatives.
Chase will provide proprietary software to customers using the online banking service.
A spokesman said in response to a question that the online services uses the technology of CheckFree Corp for the bill payment service that is part of the package.
